picture:features.src.svg.why: Scene 1 named the same five abilities (video, search without a subscription/key, keep watch, pages into spreadsheets, open pages that block bots).

section:What your AI can do with it.why: Reader listed the five abilities: bot walls, video, search without a key, watching a page, table into a spreadsheet.

picture:how.src.svg.why: Scene 2 saw the climb from a plain request to stronger levels until the page was read, and the stop at a sign-in with the app told.

section:How it gets past a wall.why: Reader described five ways of visiting tried lightest first, a sign-in wall stopping the climb, and the AI being told.

picture:install.src.svg.why: Scene 3 saw three commands in Claude Code ticking off installed, checked that it works, and says when updates come.

section:Install.why: Reader got three pasted commands that install it, check it answers, and report when an update is out.

picture:privacy.src.svg.why: Scene 4 saw everything on 'Your computer', pages going straight from the site to the AI app, with no sign-up, key or server in between.

section:Where your data goes.why: Reader said it runs on your computer and pages go from the site to you to the AI app with no server in between.
